people.name: Hiram
people.line: King of Tyre, ally of David and Solomon.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
translations.bsb: Solomon rebuilt the cities Hiram had given him and settled Israelites there.
translations.kjv: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
translations.asv: that the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
